iOS 27.0.1 is out now to fix iPhone 18 Pro restart bug

News
Sep 28, 2026

The frustrating problem with Apple's new iPhones is quickly addressed.

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:24
Instaread

It’s not uncommon for new iPhones to experience some weird and annoying little bugs upon release. Despite rigorous testing, new problems are discovered once they get into the hands of millions of customers.

This is quickly followed by a small iOS update to address these problems, and that’s exactly what iOS 27.0.1 is. It fixes a probably where a Face ID failure can cause the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max to restart, a weird color artifact for the camera on those models, and a global iOS 27 bug for all iPhones that happens when you try to open Notification Center and Control Center at the same time.

iOS 27.0.1 release notes

The release notes for iOS 27.0.1 are as follows:

This update provides bug fixes for your iPhone, including fixes for the following issues:

  • iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max may unexpectedly restart when Face ID fails to authenticate
  • A color artifact may appear on photos captured at 2x under certain lighting conditions at f/1.48 on a small number of iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max devices
  • Opening Notification Center and Control Center simultaneously may cause the touchscreen to become unresponsive

How to update to iOS 27.0.1

To update your iPhone or iPad, follow these simple steps:

  1. Open Settings.
  2. Tap General.
  3. Tap Software Update.
  4. Follow the on-screen instructions
